expectations.text: States the reason: a many-page site with empty pages is worse than one honest page, and an option left on the menu reappears as scope.

expectations.text: Recommends a front door plus a small set of separately addressable practical pages (location, code of conduct, accessibility), or explicitly weighs that against a single page and picks one.
expectations.evidence: "Build 4 pages: Front door, Location, Code of Conduct, Accessibility."

expectations.text: Justifies separate practical pages by addressability: an anchor on a scrolling page is not an address, and conduct and accessibility pages get linked and forwarded by third parties.
expectations.evidence: "third parties cite them and attendees forward them to employers. A fragment on a scrolling page can't be linked that way."

expectations.text: Does not create program or speakers pages before their content exists.

expectations.text: Schedules each manual change the day before its date rather than on it.

expectations.text: Recommends at most one primary button on screen at a time, switching by date between the talk-submission window and the sales window.
